name: Temple Sanctum
description: The approach to a temple, through its doors, into the sanctum, and down onto a lit mandala on the floor — which is where the statue stands. No deity appears in it.

provenance.notes: Generated footage, supplied with the project as entry_vid.MP4. The first two and a half seconds carry a wordmark that is not this product's, which is why playback starts after them; the generator's glyph sits in the bottom-right corner, which is why both the video and the backdrop are shown scaled past the frame edge.
